title: Make the suite and the product correct across UK midnight
requested_outcome: Full repository acceptance on a tree identical to clive/trunk ce791d032dcc8cf9b761ca40ce0b08a259c897a2 (now 631caa24) failed 3 tests when it ran across 22:59-23:01 UTC on 2026-09-24, which is midnight in Europe/London (BST), and passed at 23:10 UTC and at every other time it was run. The acceptance evidence recorded no test names. Earlier the same week two bugs of this class were found: an order's age rounded up near a day boundary, and a fixture placed part-way through a day (tests/test_fixture_wiring.py). Find every test whose outcome depends on the wall clock crossing midnight in Europe/London or in UTC, by running the offline suite with the clock held at 22:59:30, 23:00:30, 23:59:30 and 00:00:30 UTC (for example with a small helper that patches time and datetime for a run; do not rely on libfaketime). For each, fix the root cause where it lives: in the product when the owner would be told something wrong near midnight, otherwise in the fixture or test clock. Never weaken an assertion or skip a test. Add tests/test_clock_boundaries.py that drives each affected path with the clock at those four instants and asserts the correct result, so this class cannot return silently. Say in your report which tests failed at which instant and why. Run every check listed below in your workspace and fix anything it reports before you report. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: the report names every test that fails at any of the four instants and the root cause of each
each root cause is fixed where it lives; no assertion is weakened and no test is skipped or deselected
tests/test_clock_boundaries.py proves the affected paths correct at 22:59:30, 23:00:30, 23:59:30 and 00:00:30 UTC
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
